conflicts.where: Lesson 5 (rhombus kanga patch from Gikomba market)
conflicts.problem: The two data sets for the same rhombus do not match. Diagonals of 24 cm and 18 cm give A = ½×24×18 = 216 cm² and a side of √(12²+9²) = 15 cm. Sides of 15.23 cm with an angle of 56° give 15.23² × sin 56° ≈ 192.3 cm². The lesson claims both formulas give consistent results for the same shape. For a side of 15 cm to match 216 cm², the angle would need to be about 73.7°, not 56°.
